string.text: [Speed measurements] Collect the car and arrive at the marked place
Gadfly, a farm hunter, asked me to become a crazy racer.Driving 8 points at full speed sounds like some kind of madness.However, why not try?But first you need to assemble or find a car...
[Sighted] Find an unknown mutant in the Depot
Snipe asked me to deal with the mutant he came across in the Depot.You need to inspect the area and understand what is happening there.
[Sighted] Bring the PDA to Snipe
I found Khomyak's PDA, but the records on it were broken.We need to return it to Bekas - maybe he will figure out what to do with it.
Arrive at the first point
The starting point is right along the road.If I forgot something, then I have time to prepare.
Arrive at the second point
Time is limited!The second point is at the gas station!
Arrive at the third point
Time is limited!The third point is at the bridge!
Arrive at the fourth point
Time is limited!The fourth point is at the construction site!
Arrive at the fifth point
Time is limited!The fifth point is at the farm!
Arrive at the sixth point
Time is limited!The sixth point is at the bus station!
Arrive at the seventh point
Time is limited!The seventh point is at the garages!
Arrive at the eighth point
Time is limited!The eighth point is at the stop!
Return to Gadfly for your reward
The trip is over, measurements have been received, Gadfly is satisfied.We must return for our well-deserved reward.
Explore the shore
St. John's wort asked to deal with the mutants and suggested that they might be in the coastal area.We need to check out this place.
Destroy the dogs near the shore
And here are the mutants that St. John's wort was talking about.We need to shoot them, and apparently there is a hardened dog there, whose tail I will bring as evidence.
Explore the railway tunnel.
St. John's wort contacted me and suggested that the snorks were in the railway tunnel.We need to inspect this area.
Kill the snorks
There are actually snorks in the tunnel!You need to deal with them and bring 5 feet to St. John's wort as proof.
Return to St. John's wort
Having dealt with the creatures, we need to return and inform St. John's Wort about the work done.
Talk to "Stavor"
So much has been done, but essentially nothing worthwhile.I'll talk to Stavor and see how it goes.
Find out any information about Moskvich
Interesting story.He went on his own, he disappeared on his own.It can't be that simple; we need to find eyewitnesses who can tell a little more than just a story.
Find information about Moskvich in the Newcomer Village
Find out information about Moskvich from Sidorovich
I don't think that beginners can know anything about the car, but old-timer Wolf will definitely tell you.
The wolf said that he should talk to Sidorovich about this car.Knowing this dealer, the investigation may drag on...
Find information about «Moskvich» on the Stalker Database
The local merchant Shilov may know something about this car.You should ask him.
Find information about "Moskvich" at the Hunter Base
Who, if not the hunters, should be the main eyewitnesses?You should visit their camp.
Find Sidorovich's case in "Dark Hollow"
A simple errand.Apparently, it's somewhere near the bridge.Just go and pick it up.
Find a rifle on "ATP"
Plans change.It's the same as looking for a needle in a haystack... I hope you get lucky.
Take the storm to Sidorovich
Nice toy.It shoots really bad.Apparently this is what Sidorovich is waiting for now.
Explore the spatial bubble above the «Railway Embankment»
The first destination is the Spatial Bubble above the Railway Embankment.Is it worth the risk...
Explore the space bubble in the Dark Hollow
Another spatial bubble is located somewhere in the forests of Dark Hollow.You should take a look.
Collect 10 stacks of snorks and bring them to the hunters
Take 10 stacks of snorks to the hunters
Shoot local wildlife and get the coordinates of the cache for it.There really are a lot of snorkels around the gas station...
Inspect the hunter's cache
Perhaps there will be something useful in this cache to at least somehow advance the investigation.
Bring the fuel canister to Stavor
Find a fuel canister
A stalker named Stavor from the stalker base asked me to find a canister of fuel.He's an unusual guy, though.Should I go to ATP, or look for it elsewhere?
Find a box with provisions
Bring a box of provisions
The farm hunter offered me a job.You need to find a box of provisions and take it to the hunters' outpost, which is located across the bridge.
Test the cars
Why not start testing tasks with car rides?To update the task, issue the info piston: "car_test_quest_info_next"
Great ride!To complete the task, issue the information piston: "car_test_quest_info_end"
Talk to people in the camp
So I arrived.You should talk to the locals and look for some work.
Explore the hill camp
A stalker named Wolf gave me a lot of work.I'll start by exploring this camp near the ATP, maybe there'll be some leads there.
Explore the elevator
Have you moved the meeting place?It seems there was a squad of bandits at the elevator.Something doesn't add up.There is no choice, you will have to go to the elevator and look for something there.
Find the box in the Old Ruins
Everything fell into place.These three stalkers worked together with the bandits.You will definitely have to tell the wolf about this.There remains hope that the box is still in ruins.
Take the box to the Wolf
I was lucky that the bandits didn't take the box.I wonder why?All that remains is to bring it to the Wolf and report on the work done.
Enter the Dark Hollow
Looks like serious work.I have a feeling that things are not so simple here.Okay, you need to get to Dark Hollow and then think about where this farm is and where these hunters are.
Talk to the hunters
Great, here I am.You need to find out as much information as possible about the courier.
Find Courier

Hmm, not as much as I would like.So from the details - Bloodsucker and Burer live behind the «Bridge».I'm a fool, I probably should have asked the hunter a little more about them... Is the Courier really so stupid that he fell right into their clutches?
Give the case to Sidorovich
Well, finally, I found a case!The courier is dead.We need to report everything to Sidorovich.
Collect money
If this guy has been at the stalkers' base for so long, then perhaps we should work with him.It is necessary to collect 50,000 rubles and bring it to Vikhrun.
Find the Veles detector
Almost a return on my investment.There's really just one question.Where to look for this detector?
Deliver the Veles detector
Great, I have the detector.We need to deliver him to the coordinates given by Vikhrun.
Inform Vikhrun about the work done
Delivered.You need to report to Vikhrun about the work done and take your money.
[Master of the Forest] Kill the "Master of the Forest"
A seasoned boar creates a lot of trouble for stalkers in Dark Hollow.We need to deal with this carcass and bring the hoof to Sidorovich.
[Master of the Forest] Take the hoof of the «Master of the Forest» to Sidorovich
I have the hoof!It's hard though.All that remains is to hand it over to Sidorovich.
[Joining the stalkers] Find the AK-74 and modules for it
To join the group, I need to complete a small task, find an AK-74, Cobra and TGP-A.
[Joining the stalkers] Hide the AK-74 and modules in the marked place
[Joining the stalkers] Return to Valerian
[Joining the Bandits] Find two sawn-off shotguns
To join the group, you need to find a couple of sawn-off shotguns and bring them to Yoga.
[Joining the Bandits] Bring the Shotguns to Yoga
Find the tail of the Blind Dog
Take the tail of the Blind Dog
It is necessary to find the tail of a blind dog and give it to the customer.
Find Pseudops tail
Take Pseudops tail
It is necessary to find the pseudodog's tail and give it to the customer.
Find Boar's Hoof
Take the Boar's Hoof
It is necessary to find a boar's hoof and give it to the customer.
Find the Medusa artifact
Take the artifact to Medusa
It is necessary to find the «Medusa» artifact and transfer it to the customer.
Find the stone flower artifact
Take the stone flower artifact
It is necessary to find the «Stone Flower» artifact and transfer it to the customer.
Find the Night Star artifact
Take the Night Star artifact
It is necessary to find the «Night Star» artifact and transfer it to the customer.
Find rare weapon "RGM-40"
Take "RGM-40" to the customer
The customer offered to work on searching for the rare weapon «RGM-40».
Find 10 tail «Blind dog»
Deliver 10 tail «Blind dog»
The client has offered to search for 10 "Blind Dog" tails. It looks like a big order. They need to be found and delivered to the client.
Find 5 “Pseudodog” Tails
Deliver 5 “Pseudodog” Tails
The client has offered a job to find 5 “Pseudodog” Tails. Looks like a large order. You need to find them and deliver them to the client.
Find 15 “Boar” Hooves
Deliver 15 “Boar” Hooves
The client has offered a job to find 15 “Boar” Hooves. Looks like a large order. You need to find them and deliver them to the client.
Find 3 “Bloodsucker” Tentacles
Deliver 3 “Bloodsucker” Tentacles
The client has offered a job to find 3 “Bloodsucker” Tentacles. Looks like a large order. You need to find them and deliver them to the client.
PDA with only one entry
This PDA contains one single entry: «You need to find Professor Kaimanov, and receive from him further instructions to ensure his safety.»Was I looking for some professor?So far this is my only lead.
Anomalous pistol
A stalker's pistol from a village that has turned into something unusual... Apparently, it's an artifact.Slightly radioactive.
Notebook of an unknown hunter

A large number of records about the general life of a hunter.Interesting and necessary - on the last pages there is information about Moskvich.«Gravity seems like a joke to this machine.You know, I think I can guess how it works, and how it drives.I need to talk to my friend about this idea.»
Hoof of a seasoned boar
Compared to a regular hoof, it is much more fleshy and heavy.A rare trophy that has a high price among scientists.
The tail of a seasoned dog
A rare trophy of a white dog, highly prized among hunters
Hoof of a seasoned boar
Compared to a regular hoof, it is much more fleshy and heavy.A rare trophy that has a high price among scientists.
Experimental device
The device that the farm hunter gave me.There are only a couple of buttons, and the display shows nothing but unrelated numbers.
[Deal for a word] Find an artifact
[Deal for a word] Bring an artifact
Experimental device
Experimental device
[Living Corner] Find the messenger
[Living Corner] Return to Joseph
Oh... Joseph sent me for some messenger, who was most likely already devoured and stolen - I'll hope for the best

It's not usual, but the «best» turned out to be with me today - the body has been gone for a long time, but his backpack with the papers I needed was nearby.Interesting pieces of paper - probably Ioffis interesting pepper.Stalkers, bandits... I wonder who else he's dealing with?
[Help the poor and unfortunate] Get data from scanners
[Helping the poor and unfortunate] Return to Associate Professor Ivanov
Associate Professor Ivanov asked to bypass his anomalous activity scanners and collect results from them
Sidorovich... There is nothing here.There's also a dead stalker nearby.
How is there nothing?!There you go.It's not surprising though.I think I can guess who took the cargo.This stalker owed a big debt to the bandits, so he paid.
Are there any options?
Go to ATP.This is the only place they could take my cargo.Change everything there!When you find it, bring it to me.
Here we go...
Should I climb a tree?Although there is a sound coming from this bubble... You should think about it.
St. John's wort, I eliminated the dogs, among them was a seasoned dog.But I don't see the snorks you were talking about.
Strange... Maybe they fled somewhere?Exactly!Check the railway tunnel up the coast, they are most likely there.
Well, have you arrived at the place?Did you fill up the tank full?Have you changed the spark plugs?If not yet, you have time while you move to the first point.
And now... GO!GAS!You have less than 45 seconds to get to the gas station!If you don't have time, then everything is down the drain!
Hey!Do you see the road there?Or has the bureaucrat climbed under the hood again and is now steering for you?Drive further, the next point is at the old bridge.You have 50 seconds!!
ABOUT!Works!I thought it was just a flashing light.Come on, don't slow down!The next point is right along the road, in the construction area.You have just over a minute!
Your mother!Who planned this stupid route?!Stalker, drive to our sawmill!It's backwards.The device should work there.You have a little over 2 minutes.
Oh, I saw you!You're clearly faster than a hungry bloodsucker!The next point is right along the dirt road, at the bus station.You have 50 seconds!

Wow!Even the wild boars didn't make it!Although one of them seems to have written down your number - in case of «damage compensation».Continue into the garages, they should be on your right!You only have 20 seconds

The last mark is ahead!If you don't have time, I'll tell the scientists that the device was eaten by a Chernobyl cat.They will believe it.At a pace, back to the bus station, there is a bus at the stop, you need to do the measurement there.. You only have 25 seconds!
Great!It's done.If any of these smart guys asks, I'll say that you stuck a device in the chimera's teeth and showed where the tastiest stalkers live!Come back, I have something for you.
Looks like I'll have to tell stories about the cat.Let's start again, what's left.
Oh... almost!Another second and there would have been a record, but now the device is pouting like flesh on a diet.
It's a pity it didn't work out. But it's okay, for a stalker the main thing is not speed, but perseverance.Let's do it again.
-Well, now you know where the potholes are on the road.All that remains is to drive there again - but faster.
The measurements are off.The device said goodbye and went into sleep mode out of boredom.Go back, whatever's left.
Well, the measurements were off.But now, somewhere not far away, a satisfied flesh is sitting, licking your license plate.
Are you slowing down or what?Didn't have time?Okay, let's do it again.Blow on the first point.
Be careful, there's a chimera wandering nearby.They say it reacts to the sound of the engine.Although, maybe she's just jealous - she doesn't have that kind of power!
Hey stalker!Stop by my bus station, there's something to do...
Come in, the merchant has put in a good word for you!
Where am I... What happened?
Again... the head...
Oops!What is it that we have hidden here?Now mine!
Hmm... They drank well.
Patrol officers reported finding an intruder within the perimeter of the administrative complex.The command gave the order to raise the helicopter to search and eliminate the target.
I see him.He's in the building!Open fire on the windows!

Hey stalker!Can you hear me?On all military channels, you know - everyone is only talking about you.Get out of there immediately before the special forces arrive.How did you even get there?I'm waiting for you at my place, let's talk.
Research "$$ACTION_USE$$".
Pick up the «$$ACTION_USE$$» detector.
Examine the "$$ACTION_USE$$" backpack.
Find Professor Kaymanov
«You need to find Professor Kaimanov, and get further instructions from him to ensure his safety.»
Learn about yourself
What happened... Where am I?My head is still pounding...
Search the place where I was found
I don't understand anything.I need to examine the place where I was found, maybe then I'll be able to find out at least something about myself.
Talk about the information found with the Wolf
This strange PDA apparently belonged to me.Was I looking for some professor?
Gain Sidorovich's trust
To gain Sidorovich's trust, I need to find a person who can vouch for me.Perhaps we should look for people in the village...
Find a gun
After a serious drinking session, a stalker nicknamed «Kardan» lost his pistol somewhere in the village... Well, let's look for it.
Take the pistol to Cardan
Found!However, his pistol is unusual... I think Cardan will be delighted.
Talk to Sidorovich
Cardan helped me gain Sidorovich's trust.I hope he can tell at least something about Caymanov.
Talk to Father Valerian
Sidorovich promised to help with my question, but before that I will have to unravel what the military found on the territory of the «Dark Hollow».
Head to the administrative complex
The administrative complex in Dark Hollow is the military's main target.I wonder what they found there?
Explore the administrative complex
I'm inside.There are probably some materials and documents here - otherwise why would the military stick their nose here?
Leave the archive area
It is not surprising that the military came here for these materials.We need to get out of here as quickly as possible.
Talk to Sidorovich

Sighted, PSI installations, and God knows what else... It seems that this «Archive» was once a field laboratory of some group of scientists.I wonder if there might be someone among them who can shed light on my memory?We need to talk to Sidorovich about this.
Talk to the hunters in Dark Hollow
Valerian advised me to talk to the hunters and take the «Due» from them, which could help me in my business...
«Master of the Forest»
«Skilled Dog»
